tour_overview.package_name: Meditation & Yoga Holiday Tour in Sri Lanka

itinerary_breakdown.description: At the airport you will be greeted by our Jetwing Representative and your chauffeur guide who will take you to your stay in the hills of Digana, in Kandy. Enjoy a scenic drive from the coast into the mountains through ever changing landscape. Arriving at your beautiful retreat, check in and relax for the rest of the day. Practice Yoga in the afternoon. Admire the view of paddy fields from your veranda, or perhaps enjoy a stroll around the property with its lush forest paths.

After morning meditation and breakfast, take a drive down to explore the attractions of Kandy, Sri Lanka’s hill capital. Pay homage to the Temple of the Tooth Relic, which houses Sri Lanka’s most sacred relic - a tooth of the Lord Buddha. Visit the Udawattekele forest reserve or the bustling streets and market places. Take in the views from upper Lake drive. Or visit the Peradeniya Botanical Gardens. After lunch, head back to your serene sanctuary in the forest to practise Yoga or some evening meditation.

After breakfast, morning meditation or Yoga, set off to explore the forested expanse of the property for some birdwatching. Take a trek to the Huluganga waterfall through the jungle paths, and cool off with a bath in the river. You could also go on longer, more strenuous treks into the Knuckles mountains - a unique cloud forest full of endemic plants and animals. There are a variety of options to pick from depending on your level of fitness. Return to practise Yoga or some evening meditation.

Rise with the birds for meditation, Yoga and breakfast. Then you can choose to go for another nature tour with a guide, or spend the day relaxing. You could also watch a traditional cooking demonstration, and learn how wholesome Sri Lankan cuisine is made with natural, homegrown ingredients. Discover more about Sri Lankan spices and how they are blended and used. After lunch, spend the day relaxing or exploring. You will find plenty of peaceful spots to practise yoga or simply reflect in quiet meditation.
As all good things must come to an end, we bid you farewell as our chauffeur guide takes you to the Airport to meet your departure flight home.
